payload.entry: DISCOVERED ISSUE: (found by bob-cli-a0.10.1 land agent at bob-cli dadf0734) Every steps-bearing job in .github/workflows/docs-publish.yml (publish, deploy, record, verify, report) and .github/workflows/docs-weekly.yml (weekly, report) has no runs-on key (grep -c runs-on = 0 in both files). GitHub Actions rejects a called reusable workflow whose step jobs omit runs-on (Required property is missing: runs-on), so the first live publish/weekly run in bob-cli-a0.5.1.5 should fail at workflow validation. test_publish_workflow.py / test_weekly_workflow.py do not assert runs-on. Fix: add runs-on: ubuntu-latest (or the chosen runner) to each job and a test that every job with steps declares runs-on. Related: the bob-cli-a0.10.1 tale adds an actions/setup-node@v7 step before the publish job's production gate because bob-docs check --production now runs bob-plugins' Node inventory generator.

Verification: monitor p00gkv9h54xj ran `just docs-check` to exit 0 on 2026-10-20, including strict Zensical build, published URL checks, offline fragment checks, search smoke, tutorial, media determinism, and documentation tests. The first `just docs-publish` attempt (monitor gq2v1b4t1rve) failed before a workflow run was accepted: GitHub HTTP 422 rejected the reusable `docs-publish.yml` because its five jobs lacked `runs-on`. Added `runs-on: ubuntu-latest` to all five publish jobs and both weekly jobs; the exact updated source passes docs-check. Changes are pending SASE finalization before the first actual publish.
